scenarios.name: equation surface exists
scenarios.expected: Text and structured numeric leaves are present; initial pose is 30°.
scenarios.observed: Four equations, two editable leaves and linked arm loaded.

scenarios.name: lossless text to layout to text
scenarios.steps: Choose Equation text; enter exact whitespace, comments and padded decimals; apply; switch layout/text twice.
scenarios.expected: Source bytes and numeric spelling are unchanged; geometry uses L=100.5, θ=30.

observed.exactSource:
L  =  00100.5000 mm # length
θ = +030.000 deg
x = L · cos(θ)
y = L * sin(θ)

scenarios.name: two structured edits and cancel
scenarios.steps: Switch to layout; edit length, then angle without applying between them; press Escape.
scenarios.expected: Both leaf edits coexist; cancel restores the exact source and endpoint.
scenarios.observed: Sibling length edit retained while editing angle; Escape restored source and geometry.

scenarios.name: structured commit and shared history
scenarios.steps: Edit both layout leaves; apply once; Undo then Redo.
scenarios.expected: One undo restores both precise numbers and geometry; redo restores the joint change.

observed.exactSource:
L  =  00120.2500 mm # length
θ = +045.000 deg
x = L · cos(θ)
y = L * sin(θ)

scenarios.name: incomplete structured leaf recovery
scenarios.steps: Clear length; type an incomplete value; repair it in the same leaf; edit its sibling; cancel.
scenarios.expected: Incomplete text remains editable, cannot apply, and leaves committed geometry intact. Repair retains both edits.
scenarios.observed: Hole and malformed number retained; repair and sibling edit succeeded; cancel restored the applied state.

scenarios.name: malformed source and layout fallback
scenarios.steps: Enter an unsupported relation with literal HTML; switch layout/text; try to apply; cancel.
scenarios.expected: Exact unsupported text survives; it is inert, apply is disabled and the endpoint stays at the applied state.
scenarios.observed: Unsupported draft retained as inert text in both representations; cancel restored exact equations.

scenarios.name: domain rejection
scenarios.steps: Enter 39.999 mm, 140.001 mm and 91° in text; cancel each draft.
scenarios.expected: Each violates a named bound; cannot apply or move the arm.
scenarios.observed: All three bounds rejected; source retained until explicit cancel.

scenarios.name: keyboard geometry preview and cancellation
scenarios.steps: Focus the arm; press Up three times; inspect text/layout; press Escape.
scenarios.expected: Only theta becomes +048.000; Escape restores +045.000 and all other text exactly.
scenarios.observed: Three keys created one cancellable angle preview; exact non-angle source retained.

scenarios.name: slider keyboard commit and undo
scenarios.steps: Focus range; End to 90°; apply; Undo.
scenarios.expected: Whole-degree endpoint at 90°; exact padded angle updates; undo restores both equations and geometry.
scenarios.observed: 90° preview applied as one history entry; undo restored the exact prior document.

scenarios.name: pointer drag, commit and shared undo
scenarios.steps: Drag the endpoint normally to 60°; release; apply; inspect source; undo.
scenarios.expected: Preview updates only theta; a single undo restores exact text and endpoint.
scenarios.observed: Normal mouse drag previewed 60°, applied once, and undid to exact text/geometry.

scenarios.name: pointer interruption, focus loss and no-op
scenarios.steps: Preview a pose; deliver pointercancel and window blur separately; click the unchanged endpoint.
scenarios.expected: Both interruption routes restore exact equations; a no-op cannot add a history entry.
scenarios.observed: Synthetic interruption events cancelled; normal no-op click retained source spelling.

scenarios.name: Moxi trace projection agreement
scenarios.steps: Compare all 91 displayed Moxi samples with analytic quarter-circle projection.
scenarios.expected: Each point agrees within 0.02 SVG pixels.

scenarios.name: fractional endpoint no-op
scenarios.steps: Apply a precise fractional angle; click its unchanged endpoint; Undo.
scenarios.expected: A no-op click preserves the fractional token exactly; Undo restores the preceding document.
scenarios.observed: Precise fractional angle unchanged by an endpoint click; undo restored the preceding text.

scenarios.name: narrow layout and edit/undo
scenarios.steps: Resize to 390×844; enter and apply a text length edit; undo; inspect layout.
scenarios.expected: No document overflow; both representations remain operable, with exact undo.
scenarios.observed: 390px layout fits and text edit/undo restores the precise layout leaf.

scenarios.expected: Starter returns; no uncaught browser errors or failed requests.
